title: SALT
subtitle: The Empire's Smallest Fear
logline: In 1930, the British Raj taxed the one thing every Indian could gather for free. One man picked up a handful of salt, and the Empire discovered a weapon it could not arrest.

series.name: THE RECORD ROOM
series.tagline: History, one page at a time.

style.look: dawn salt flat, deep teal shadows, warm rim light, visible dust, restrained typography
rules: Show the object before the explanation.
One idea per shot. No wall of text.
The camera moves with purpose: push, reveal, or follow. Never drift without a reason.
Sound carries the scale: wind, footsteps, distant surf, a low drone, then silence before the turn.
Violence is implied through sound and aftermath, never lingered on.

blender.role: 3D sets, hero stills, camera moves, render passes, procedural salt flat, marchers, crystals

cascadeur.version: Indie (paid) or Free for non-commercial tests
cascadeur.role: character animation and physics-assisted poses; exported as FBX/GLB
cascadeur.constraint: FBX export requires Indie or Pro. Free exports .casc only. Run on the owner machine, not GitHub Actions.

embergen.role: fire, smoke, dust and fluid simulations; exported as VDB or flipbook
embergen.constraint: Needs a GPU. Bake once on the owner machine and store the VDB/flipbook in assets/vfx/.

blenderkit.role: CC0 and royalty-free props, anatomy, tools and environments
blenderkit.constraint: Record the license and source URL in assets/library/manifest.json.

sketchfab.role: CC0/CC-BY models for monuments, objects and anatomy
sketchfab.constraint: Download only assets whose license allows commercial use. Record attribution.

after_effects.role: online edit, parallax, grade, typography, sound design
after_effects.constraint: Adobe does not run on GitHub Actions. The repository exports layered plates, an EDL and a shot manifest.

premiere_pro.role: final conform, mix and YouTube master
premiere_pro.constraint: Owner-machine finishing step. The CI cut is an animatic, not the final online.

python.role: Blender scene assembly, naming, pass rendering, validation and batch exports

node.role: orchestration, schema validation, ffmpeg assembly, caption and thumbnail generation
